## Field benchmark — `kb-evaluations-agentstudio-2026-07`

**Feature:** KB-Evaluations · **Recorded:** 2026-07-23

- **Target:** [AgentStudio](https://github.com/NetApp-Nemo/AgentStudio) (brownfield)
- **Jira:** [KAN-53](https://netapp.atlassian.net/browse/KAN-53)
- **Shipped:** [PR #465](https://github.com/NetApp-Nemo/AgentStudio/pull/465)
- **PRD source:** `KB-Evaluations-PRD-2.odt`

| Arm | Wall-clock | Notes |
|-----|------------|-------|
| NetApp GSD recipe | 3–6 h | Recipe on AgentStudio: PRD intake, phased plan/execute, verify, ship, Jira traceability |
| Ad-hoc (vibe coding) | 16 h (~2 calendar days operator-reported) | Same feature scope without recipe structure or gates |

**Outcome:** Recipe path ~3–6 h vs ad-hoc ~2 days on equivalent KB-Evaluations scope

**Caveats:**
- Single operator, single feature — not N=5 harness runs
- Same operator for both arms — learning/order effects possible
- Brownfield monorepo — not comparable to greenfield Uber-Eats harness tasks
- Wall-clock includes context switches; not pure coding time
- Quality validated via PR/CI, not bench/grade/grade.sh

**Citation:**

> KB-Evaluations on AgentStudio (KAN-53, PR #465): NetApp GSD recipe vs ad-hoc — field benchmark `kb-evaluations-agentstudio-2026-07`, 2026-07-23.

## Adding a field benchmark

1. Copy [benchmarks/schema.json](benchmarks/schema.json) shape.
2. Add `docs/netapp-recipe/benchmarks/<id>.json`.
3. Run `bench/lib/generate-recipe-benchmarks.sh`.
4. Re-install or refresh targets so `docs/RECIPE-BENCHMARKS.md` updates.

## Harness benchmark (formal)

Run controlled arms per [../../RUNBOOK.md](../../RUNBOOK.md):

```bash
./bench/runners/prepare-run.sh runs/baseline/run-01   # ad-hoc on SPEC
./bench/runners/prepare-run.sh runs/gsd/run-01        # vanilla GSD
./bench/runners/prepare-run.sh runs/recipe/run-01     # recipe arm
./bench/runners/finalize-run.sh <arm> run-01
python3 bench/report/aggregate.py
python3 bench/report/kpi.py
```
